What the 2026 research shows

Everyone has AI. Why are you still chasing updates?

AI can help each person finish their task. Someone still has to turn those separate tasks into one finished result.

83%

of respondents agree AI has made individuals more productive.

What this means for your team

A faster draft is useful. But a finished sales draft still needs delivery, finance, and legal to do their part.

02 · Others still need the context

69%

say most AI-assisted work happens in private sessions rather than shared spaces.

What this means for your team

One person’s AI conversation does not automatically update a colleague’s plan. Someone must share the decision and its implications.

03 · The handoffs need a workflow

29%

of knowledge workers have embedded AI in their flow of work, even as 85% use it at work.

What this means for your team

Using AI is one step. Getting the right information to the next person, securing approval, and updating the systems is the rest.

Watch this play out in one proposal

Five people do their jobs.
Leah still has to connect the work.

First, the manual way. A client adds a location. Leah chases the staffing, price, contract, and approval updates.

Then, a connected workflow. The change reaches each owner. Their approved decisions update the next step and the final proposal.
